# Symbols file icons

SVG icons and the VS Code file-icon theme manifest from
[`miguelsolorio/vscode-symbols`](https://github.com/miguelsolorio/vscode-symbols)
at commit `296ef1b62287fb2315cb5651e552e09e8c8e1de8`, as bundled by
[Zeron](https://github.com/zeronsh/zeron) (`crates/ui/assets/file-icons`,
commit `a7947b72`). MIT licensed; see `LICENSE.symbols`.

`scripts/generate.mjs` turns these into `generated/file-icons.ts`.
